ce_bugs.text: packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts:8 — Token refresh requests send no authentication proof to the configured sync endpoint, so anyone who can reach it can request bearer tokens for guessed user IDs and app slugs.

apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts:62 — The find-then-create sequence is non-atomic, so concurrent deliveries can create duplicate credentials and leave later updates targeting an arbitrary stale row.
apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts:73 — Credential updates have no event version or replay guard, so a delayed or replayed webhook can overwrite newer OAuth tokens with stale credentials.

packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts:3 — The helper erases its return type with any while alternately returning Fetch and SDK responses, so incompatible token shapes reach callers unchecked.

packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts:13 — The parser accepts any and ZodTypeAny then returns a SafeParse union after throwing on failure, discarding caller token types and exposing an impossible branch.
